task.title: Add horizontal alignment checks and audit facade
task.summary: Add first-class horizontal alignment checks under flat src/checks/** modules, with src/audit as the facade/tool surface and gateway evidence support.

goal.outcome: Gateway and audit can consume deterministic horizontal alignment evidence from flat src/checks/** modules while audit remains a facade/tool surface.
acceptance: Checks layer exposes horizontal KB↔KB checks for deterministic conflicting/stale/duplicate canonical claims.
Checks layer exposes code↔code checks for API/ownership/import-contract drift using source graph evidence.
Checks layer exposes KB↔code checks comparing documented paths/claims to source graph and task/build evidence.
Audit facade exposes the horizontal-alignment profile without owning low-level check implementation.
Gateway preflight/report can require and cite horizontal-alignment check evidence.
non_goals: Do not attempt unconstrained LLM semantic contradiction detection.
Do not block on low-confidence prose similarity alone.
Do not leave horizontal alignment implementation owned by src/audit/**.
verification: source search proves horizontal-alignment implementation lives under src/checks/** and audit is a facade.

delta.desired: Horizontal alignment lives under flat src/checks/** and is exposed by audit/gateway surfaces.
delta.current: Horizontal alignment implementation was initially staged under src/audit/**, but approved architecture says checks own deterministic evidence and audit is a facade.
delta.closure: Close when checks layer, audit facade, docs, tests, and gateway evidence support align and validation passes.
